name: keycaps
title: Keycaps
description: Compact Tailwind keyboard-key atoms for documenting shortcuts and command hints.
useWhen: A keyboard action is useful context for an available command or shortcut.
avoidWhen: The key is not a real, supported interaction in the product.
responsiveBehavior: Keycaps retain their compact intrinsic size and flow with their surrounding text.
accessibility: Uses semantic kbd elements for individual keys.
Keep shortcut text understandable without relying on symbols alone.

variants.title: Keycap
variants.description: A single keyboard key with the slight depth and monospace treatment users recognize.

variants.title: Shortcut
variants.description: A compact inline group for combining several keycaps into one documented keyboard command.
accessibility: Use readable text or an aria-label for symbol-only shortcuts.
